data.why: the repo bundles mock_qpcr_384well.csv, a realistic RT-qPCR plate layout (Well, Target, Sample, Cq, Group) with multiple housekeeping and target genes and replicate triplicates, which is exactly the file format the app's Upload step expects.

goals: upload a plate of Ct values and confirm the app auto-detects Well/Target/Sample/Cq/Group columns
review replicate triplicates and exclude outlier wells before quantification
pick one or more housekeeping genes and compute housekeeping-normalized ΔCt for every target
designate a reference biological group and compute batch-aware ΔΔCt relative expression
inspect bar plots of relative expression per target gene across samples/groups
download the Excel workbook or CSV bundle of raw, ΔCt, and ΔΔCt results

review.summary: The tree follows the README's seven-step ΔCt/ΔΔCt workflow closely: phases, tasks and features match the interface, the check run replayed all of it, and 10 of the 11 screens I opened show what their nodes claim. It needs small fixes before filing: one wrong screen citation, group assignment marked optional and the overview tasks placed before step 3, missing column-correction and housekeeping-skip tasks, and a few stray task links on features.
